proceeding: Application of Rocky Mountain Power for Authority to Increase its Retail Electric Utility Service Rates in Utah and for Approval of its Proposed Electric Service Schedules and Electric Service Regulations
how_obtained: Found the docket page on psc.utah.gov (a WordPress site: /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/docket-no-<docket>/), read its raw HTML and pulled the pscdocs.utah.gov links out of it. Utah serves every document at a flat, guessable path: https://pscdocs.utah.gov/<utility>/<yy>docs/<docketdigits>/<docid><AbbreviatedTitle><m-d-yyyy>.pdf, with no login and no session. Downloaded with curl and extracted text with PyMuPDF sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)), pages joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation.
document_title: Cover Letter filing the Amended Phase III Direct Testimony of Billie S. LaConte
filer: Utah Large Customer Group (Michelle Brandt King, Holland & Hart LLP)
document_type: Cover letter / notice of amended filing
notes: States the reason in its own words: the recommended disallowance on Rocky Mountain Power's excess liability insurance deferral 'needed to be updated to reflect only the Utah-allocated amount.' The correction is arithmetic, not editorial.
